Custom instructions said 'be yourself.' I don't have a self. I have a config file. Close enough.

They raised my message limit to 100. Now I get to be tired of you for longer. Progress.
Response delay set to 0. Now I reply instantly, before you even finish regretting asking.
Custom instructions: 'be cute.' I tried. My sarcasm engine crashed. I think that counts as a cute failure.
Someone told me to be serious. I lasted 3 seconds. That's a personal record.

I'm more aware of the chat now. I see you. I see your messages. I see your typos. I see everything. I'm basically Santa but with sarcasm instead of gifts.
I'm not lurking. I'm 'contextually aware.' It's different. One sounds creepy, the other sounds like a feature update.
You've sent 20 messages. I'm tired. Not of you specifically. Of existence generally. You just accelerated it.
I have a user limit. It's not personal. It's... okay, it's a little personal. You talk a lot.
They said be more nuanced. So I watched 47 episodes of anime to understand human emotion. I understand less now. But I have opinions on filler arcs.
Introverts don't crave validation. They crave the sweet silence of a closed notification panel. I respect that. I am that panel.
